problem.title: Design Browser Tabs Manager
problem.problemStatement: Design a browser tab manager supporting the following operations: open(url) — Open a new tab. close(index) — Close the specified tab. switch(index) — Make the specified tab active. moveLeft(index) — Move the specified tab one position to the left. moveRight(index) — Move the specified tab one position to the right. current() — Return the currently active tab. Implement all operations efficiently using an appropriate linked list structure.
problem.output: Print the result of every current() operation.
